description: This file implements functions for handling atomic counters in HLSL shader code, including generating function names, function headers, and binding names related to atomic counters.

classes.name: AtomicCounterFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class for generating HLSL functions for atomic counter operations, including function name management and header code generation.

methods.name: useAtomicCounterFunction
methods.description: Generates and returns the HLSL function name for a given atomic counter operation.

methods.name: atomicCounterFunctionHeader
methods.description: Outputs the HLSL function definitions for atomic counter operations based on internal state.

methods.name: getAtomicCounterNameForBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding name string for an atomic counter based on its binding index.
